behavior: Intentionally omitted state permits mismatched callback; unsafe reproduction paired with restored-state control.
limitations: A passed reproduction is evidence of the anti-example vulnerability, not a passed control.

behavior: Real signed ID tokens with wrong issuer/nonce do not increment session-creation counter.
limitations: Synthetic issuer, direct PyJWT verifier; not complete OIDC middleware/provider conformance.

behavior: PyJWT RSA signature, algorithm/key, issuer/audience/time/purpose/required-claim checks; untrusted key selector causes no fetch.
limitations: No JWKS discovery, rotation or remote provider; key selector/nonce/purpose guards are fixture code.

behavior: Authlib HTTP refresh with concurrent single-use token, wrong recipient/purpose denial and synthetic issuer-side revocation.
limitations: Issuer state is synthetic/in-memory; no real provider, sender constraint, token-family policy or distributed crash recovery.

behavior: Actual MongoDB operator-shaped input broadens unsafe query; safe typed literal query and benign dollar-string work.
limitations: One equality-query contract; not all MongoDB operators, aggregations, LDAP, XPath or prototype mutation.

behavior: Actual Jinja evaluates unsafe interpolated template source; safe template data preserves expressions without sentinel disclosure.

limitations: Rich HTML sanitizers and all sinks not tested.

behavior: Next unstable_cache actual hits (stable computation UUID), actor/variant separation and post-hit revocation; unsafe leak reproduced.
limitations: Next Data Cache only; not use-cache directive, CDN/shared HTTP cache, real sessions or distributed invalidation.

behavior: Chromium blocks cross-origin frame, permits same-origin frame; report-only remains permissive.
limitations: Distinct loopback origins, one browser version; same-origin parent served by Playwright routing; no full frame nesting matrix.

behavior: Chromium enforces script CSP, permits nonce script, executes unsafe/report-only payload.
limitations: CSP script subset only; no HSTS, nosniff, referrer policy or full header bundle; fixture nonce is fixed, not production guidance.
